neighbours.label: the ellipsis character '…' marking omitted words inside a quotation; the same quotation without the ellipsis, and casual trailing dots, stay low
fire: The judge wrote that the law "must be applied … without fear or favour."
In his diary he noted, "We marched all day. … The men are exhausted."
The memo said the plan was "too costly … and politically risky."
She recalled her mother's words: "Be patient. … Good things take time."
The critic called the film "long, slow … and strangely moving."
The treaty promised "peace between the nations … for all time."
He quoted the report, which found "serious failures … at every level."
The letter ends, "Give my love to the children. … I will write soon."
